purpose: Teach: すてき/好ん/呟い/見失っ/うまかっ/脱ぎ/日当たり/当っ

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前の制服、すてきだぜ
lines.en: Riku, your uniform looks really sharp.
lines.style: Bright, approving tone with a slight tease underneath. Quick delivery, confident. The kind of compliment that lands easy between friends.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、ぼくが好んで食べるラーメン屋、行こうぜ、桜
lines.en: Come on, let's hit up that ramen place you know I like, Sakura.
lines.style: Light, forward-leaning energy. A little eager beneath the cool exterior. Direct invitation, no hesitation — like he's been thinking about it.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、テスト中に何呟いてたんだ?
lines.en: What were you muttering about during the test anyway?
lines.style: Playful accusation. Slight laugh in the voice. Leans in like she's caught him at something. Expects him to get flustered.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、運動会で集合場所を見失ってたな、桜
lines.en: You totally lost track of where the meet-up was supposed to be at the sports day, didn't you?
lines.style: Gentle teasing, almost sympathetic. Bringing up something he noticed. Soft smile in the delivery — not mean, just pointing out her mess-up fondly.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前のお母さんのお弁当、うまかったぜ
lines.en: Your mom's bento was seriously delicious, by the way.
lines.style: Genuine, warm praise. No performance. Natural compliment, like she's been wanting to mention it. Sincere appreciation in the tone.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、体育で上着を脱ぎ忘れたな、桜
lines.en: You forgot to put your jacket back on in PE, remember?
lines.style: Wry amusement. Dry observation delivered with a small knowing smile. Not mocking — just stating what he caught. Slightly amused at her carelessness.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前の部屋、日当たりいいよな
lines.en: Your room gets really nice sunlight, doesn't it?
lines.style: Casual observation with genuine warmth. Offhand compliment, like she noticed it when she wasn't expecting to. Relaxed, comfortable tone.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前の予想が見事に当ったな、桜
lines.en: Your prediction about that was spot on, Sakura.
lines.style: Quiet admiration breaking through. Surprised respect in the tone. Brief, genuine — the kind of compliment he doesn't give lightly. Almost vulnerable.
